verdict.rationale: Gumloop's docs explicitly support autonomous background automations via scheduled triggers (recurring/one-time), app triggers, and webhook triggers, plus goal-directed agents that decide tool calls autonomously, with human-in-the-loop approvals only for sensitive actions. This directly matches setting up automations that run without manual initiation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of reliability and uptime of scheduled/background runs beyond vendor docs.
